scoring_justification: Cannot recompute epsilon from raw DFT outputs; compare reported values and nonmonotonic trend against hidden reference from paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference epsilon values for BCZ compositions from paper Figure 1 (DFT-LDA, 2x2x2 supercells, directionally averaged, T=0 K).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper DOI:10.1021/cm800929e, Figure 1 black circles: BaZrO3 epsilon=50, x=0.125 peak ~68, x=0.25 ~58, x=0.5 ~42. These values are read from the figure and from the solve.sh baseline.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper Figure 1 and from solve.sh hardcoded values that approximate the paper's computed data points.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken directly from the paper's published results; they represent the target dielectric constants for the specified compositions.

schema.description: composition_x (float): Ca mole fraction. epsilon (float): directionally averaged static dielectric constant (dimensionless).

outputs.description: Static dielectric constant (directionally averaged) for each specified BCZ composition (x=0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5). The checker compares the values and their trend to a hidden reference from the paper.

output_contract.notes: Only the dielectric constants are scored; phonon frequencies and structural parameters are not evaluated. The compositions are x = 0, 0.125, 0.25, and 0.5.
